layout: uint16 pos[n][2] (quantised over box), then float16 field[source][channel][n] times scale[channel]; the first n_surface points lie on the airfoil

attribution.authors: Florent Bonnet, Jocelyn Ahmed Mazari, Paola Cinnella, Patrick Gallinari
attribution.paper: AirfRANS: High Fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics Dataset for Approximating Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes Solutions (NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks)
attribution.note: Derived from AirfRANS: fields are cropped, downsampled and stored at reduced precision, alongside model predictions.
